cards.name: hero
cards.question: Aspect Ratio Calculator
cards.qualifier: Type a width and height to get the aspect ratio, or pick a ratio and one side to get the other. A table of recommended social media image sizes is built in.

cards.name: how-to
cards.title: How to use this aspect ratio calculator

steps.title: Find the ratio
steps.text: Choose Find the ratio and enter a Width (px) and Height (px).

steps.title: Rounding to whole pixels
steps.text: Images can't have half pixels, so results are rounded.

groups.label: 4:5: the tallest feed post
groups.text: 4:5 is the portrait shape for Instagram, Facebook and Threads feed posts.

groups.label: 9:16: full-screen vertical
groups.text: 9:16 is the full-screen phone shape for TikTok videos.
